errors.text_span: 刻度间隔为每年 1 年
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are labeled every two years (1946, 1948, 1950, etc.), not every year.
The description fails to mention the second data series in the plot, which is a dotted blue line representing a trend.

errors.text_span: 从 1946 年的约 10 开始
errors.evidence: The solid line starts near 0 in 1946, not at approximately 10.

errors.text_span: 在 1950 年达到约 60 的峰值
errors.evidence: The peak in 1950 is at approximately 50, not 60. Furthermore, this is not the highest peak; the highest peak occurs around 1952 at a value of approximately 65, which is not mentioned.

errors.text_span: 然后下降到 1954 年的约 30
errors.evidence: In 1954, the value of the solid line is approximately 14, not 30.
In 1968, the line shows a major peak with a value of nearly 50. The description incorrectly states that it is a drop to a value of 20.

errors.text_span: 在 1990 年达到约 15, 在 2000 年达到约 20
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line reached values of 15 and 20 in 1990 and 2000, respectively. In reality, the line is nearly flat and very close to 0 during this entire period.

errors.text_span: 逐渐稳定到 2018 年的约 5
errors.evidence: The line ends in 2018 at a value slightly below zero, not at 5.
